name: Isliid Empire
event_description:
Rayas, aspiring to be a first-class adventurer,
takes the Guild's initiation exam but is
interrupted when he finds a girl with amnesia 
named Iris.

name: Republic of Gramenia
event_description:
After driving away Grad from the Demonseal 
Tower, Roy takes Rayas and Iris to Gramenia
in search of someone who can help their quest.

name: West Famelle
event_description:
Rayas' group learns the Towers are the key
to releasing the sealed Demons. Together
with Fen, they head to the Royal Library 
of Lagan.

name: East Famelle
event_description:
Rayas is stunned when he sees a girl that 
resembles Iris. However, he soon recovers 
his determination and hurries for Liima to stop 
the Demons' plot.

name: Sealed Fortress Gormarey
event_description:
No matter what happens, Rayas wants to 
protect his allies. He lets that intent guide 
him into Gormarey in order to end the battle
with Ragsherum.

name: Principality of Bamint
event_description:
To ascertain the truth of Mira's imprisonment,
Rayas and Iris head for Bamint, praying for
her safety along the way.

name: Magus Empire of La Riiz
event_description:
Mira vanishes, leaving behind ominous words.
Rayas' group continues to La Riiz to stop the 
cult there with the help of Melia.

name: Aerial City, La Riiz
event_description:
As Melia's consciousness fades, she whispers
that she does not want to lose anyone else.
Rayas goes to the floating city, shouldering 
her will.

name: Isliid Underground Cavern
event_description:
Determined to protect Humanity from
the revived threats of Giaveil and Za'remnah,
Rayas and his allies hurry back to Isliid.

name: The Sealed Holy Land
event_description:
Celia is the enemy. The world is turned 
upside-down. The Ancients. Iris' memories. 
His allies. Celia herself. As countless emotions 
flood his mind, he nears the conclusion.

name: North Famelle
event_description:
A new adventure in Raktehelm begins!
The Cult has invaded every country with 
a Demonseal Tower However, those are not 
their only targets...

name: Central Gramenia
event_description:
Rayas and the Zero Guard
have sworn to return Iris to Isliid safely.
However, they need more than determination
to overcome what looms before them...

name: South Bamint
event_description:
Fen has identified an Ancient leading
the Cult's forces. He takes Rayas' party
to Bamint in order to retrieve the weapon
which once defeated Celia, Grand Scale.

name: North La Riiz
event_description:
The Ancients have finally taken Iris.
Though wrestling with their own regrets,
everyone decides to turn the chase around
and attack the Cult's base: La Riiz.

name: South La Riiz
event_description:
Rayas pushes ever onward,
no matter what pushes back.
With an indomitable spirit,
he traverses the Magus Empire.

name: North Isliid
event_description:
"Are you my enemy?"
As promise and hate mingle,
Rayas reaches for
the sword of hope.

name: West Isliid
event_description:
The Imperial Blades
have shattered the binds.
As two worlds reconverge,
a new age dawns on Raktehelm.

name: West Gramenia
event_description:
Two worlds gradually converge,
rejoining the Eight Great Races.
The children of Gran Verge swear to reclaim
their sword and their kingdom.

name: East Gramenia
event_description:
The World Drops quietly hum.
As a former servant dives into the abyss,
her friend charges to the rescue.

name: South Gramenia
event_description:
Irrationality must be resisted.
At the end of his long journey,
the solitary strategist finds himself...

name: West La Riiz
event_description:
By the meteor impact site in La Riiz,
two old comrades determine which
of them gave up on their desires.

name: East La Riiz
event_description: When the meteors fell, one gave rise to a star of hope.

name: West Bamint
event_description:
Beneath the ivy-covered walls, 
two sisters clash blades.
Between past and future, her heart burns bright.

name: South Iscator
event_description:
Carried by hope and remorse,
Hart the Bulletmancer arrives on
Iscator. There, he is surprised to see
a familiar face far from home.

name: Central Iscator
event_description:
On the new continent of Iscator
where numerous hopes meet,
a single-minded ruler faces them all.

name: East Iscator
event_description:
Two shadows overlap after
countless years, giving rise
to a new miracle.

name: North Iscator
event_description:
With a swing of Rune Sovereign,
Emperor Isliid splits the sky
to pry open the door to a new world.

name: Iscator Skies
event_description:
One started with despair, the other with hope.
Beneath the World Tree in the skies above,
Rayas clashes with his former friend.

name: Northeast La Riiz
event_description:
Those words would eventually bring doom.
On the day the stars fell upon Raktehelm,
a new life and a new world began to stir.

name: Deus Gate
event_description:
Awaiting beyond is
the aerial realm of Altohelm.
Here, Rayas meets with a new fate.

name: Central Deus Gate
event_description:
On Altohelm's floating landmasses,
Rayas and his allies are caught
in the scheme between Gods and Demons.

name: Inner Deus Gate
event_description:
While battling the Divine Knights,
Rayas encounters another
wielder of the Kingdom Blade.

name: North Falfania
event_description: Light pours, and the qualified gather. The Great Seal Banquet begins.

name: Central Falfania
event_description:
Rayas' party enters the forest.
They head further eastward,
towards the former site of Granadia.
